context.transcript:
We hope you're enjoying your flight with Light Speed
Airlines this morning. If I can have your attention for one
moment, I'd like to tell you about a special promotion we're
offering. ® This month only, when you sign up for our Light
Speed Airlines rewards program, you'll be entered into a
contest to win two round-trip tickets to Paris! Enrolling in the
rewards program is a very simple process, and the brochure
in your seat-back pocket explains how to do it. And ® now,
flight attendants will be coming around with a selection of
snacks.
T.
